results.title: Diary Of A CEO: w/ Behaviour Expert Chase Hughes (Transcript) – The Singju Post
results.content:
Editor’s Notes: In this episode of The Diary Of A CEO, Steven Bartlett sits down with world-leading behavior expert Chase Hughes to uncover the hidden mechanics of human influence and “dark psychology.” Hughes explains how techniques like micro-compliance and shifting context can be used to read minds, sway juries, and navigate high-stakes negotiations. The conversation delves into the power of resonance over direction in communication, offering practical insights into how understanding behavioral patterns can transform both your professional and personal life. It is a fascinating exploration of the animalistic parts of our brains that often dictate our decisions long before we become conscious of them. (Mar 19, 2026)

TRANSCRIPT:

## The Most Important Human Skill in the Age of AI [...] CHASE HUGHES: 100%. Yeah. It’s so much more real than this reality. It’s so ineffable, there are no words that can describe it. But it’s a thousand, maybe a million times more real than this, in such a way that just coming back to this feels like everything is kind of claymation for a little while. Claymation, or just fake, like a cartoon of some kind. It’s just really low resolution. [...] CHASE HUGHES: It means that if we are in a conversation, I become more likely to help you achieve the outcome that I see for you. So if I’m a leader, then I can do that. If I’m an attorney, I can sway a jury, I can make a jury pick a certain decision. If I’m a hostage negotiator, I save people’s lives. If I’m a parent, I raise better kids because I can communicate in a way that gets the outcome that I’m looking for from another person.

results.title: The Behavior Operations Manual: Neuro-Cognitive Intelligence: Hughes, Chase: 9781735141640: Amazon.com: Books
results.content:
So what was it that Chase knew? He knew the dark truth of how to control minds—not just HOW mind control works, but HOW to actually do it. Not the sci-fi fantasy—the real thing, the kind of mind control that shatters lives, destroys innocence, manipulates the conscience, and gets people to confess things that aren't for their own good. But he also knew how that same how-to knowledge could be used to save lives, liberate minds, and protect the innocent. Chase Hughes, the world’s foremost expert on this extreme science, could have used his power for anything—influence, riches, domination. But instead, he chose a different path. [...] I used to think the goal was mastery. Control. Influence.

Now I think it’s something quieter:

seeing clearly, without flinching.

And maybe helping someone else see clearly too, without getting swallowed by noise.

I write books for people who are starting to unzip the costume - and some who have stripped it off.

People who want to understand others, but also want to understand the thing inside themselves that keeps steering their life when they’re not looking.

If you’re here, you’re probably one of those people.

Good. We need more of you.

— Chase
